title: Sergeant Plan Of Education
definition: The Sergeant Plan of Education, officially titled 'Post-War Educational Development in India', was a comprehensive 1944 blueprint prepared by the Central Advisory Board of Education (CABE) to reconstruct and universalize the Indian educational system over a 40-year period.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Modern Indian History (GS-1) focusing on British colonial policy, evolution of modern education, and nationalist responses. Also connects with Post-Independence educational policy roots (Kothari Commission, Radhakrishnan Commission) tested in Mains GS-1/GS-2.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Sergeant Plan Of Education.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
